chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from al-Barqī, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Hishām ibn al-Ḥakam and Ḥafṣ:
That Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام used to apply depilatory lime to his armpits in the bathhouse.

key_terms.يَطْلِي: he would apply a depilatory substance

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام do in the bathhouse regarding grooming?
ai.summary: This report states that Imam Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام used depilatory lime on his armpits while in the bathhouse. It reflects practical conduct and etiquette related to personal cleanliness and grooming.
